subject: Pilot demo — compact blocks to fit FY planning window
messages:

Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot demo — compact blocks to fit FY planning window

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the time last week. We scoped a short pilot tailored to your inference-heavy pipelines and put together a compact runbook and demo plan to minimize calendar friction while your finance team goes through the FY refresh.

Attached: MAV-pilot-scope.pdf (3 pages) — shows a 2-week pilot broken into four 30-min walkthrough micro-sessions (data prep, integration, perf baseline, go/no-go).

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 05/19 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Thu 05/21 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30

If those are tight because of travel or budget syncs, we can also compress into two back-to-back 45-min sessions on a single day. Let me know what works for you and I’ll send invites.

CCing Karthik (solutions) and Laura (sales ops) so we can adjust scope and paperwork quickly if Procurement needs tighter timelines.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachment: MAV-pilot-scope.pdf (PDF, 312 KB)
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@arcadiaai.com>

Cc: Procurement <procure@arcadiaai.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 14:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot demo — compact blocks to fit FY planning window

Thanks, Hannah. Appreciate the compact plan — that’s exactly the kind of flexibility we need. A couple of constraints on our side: our VP of ML is traveling the week of 05/18 for a partner summit and Finance has a short planning blackout the week of 05/25 for the FY reset. Procurement is also reconciling vendor terms for Q3 spend.

Would you be able to:
- Move sessions earlier in the week of 05/11–05/15 (we could do two 30-min blocks spread over two mornings), or
- If not, compress to a single day on 05/22 (two 45-min blocks) — but Procurement warns that PO timing may slip into June if we don’t align with their committee this month.

I’m looping Procurement on timing: procure@arcadiaai.com — they can advise on the PO cadence and whether we need an MSA before pilot.

—Elena
Elena Soto | Head of Platform Partnerships
Arcadia AI
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot demo — compact blocks to fit FY planning window

Hi all — quick note from Solutions side. We can certainly compress the technical portions. Two options that minimize context switching for your team:

Option A (preferred): Two 30-min mornings (data prep + perf baseline) on 05/14 and 05/15 at 09:30 PT. Keeps the integration work low-lift and avoids the 05/22 Procurement cliff.

Option B: Single-day compression — two 45-min blocks on 05/22 at 10:00 PT. We’ll need a short pre-call (15 min) to confirm access and sample payloads.

If Procurement anticipates sign-off late, we can run a non-prod demo (no live keys) to unblock evaluation and timeline the SOW / PO in parallel. I’ve attached a draft SOW with minimal terms we typically use — Laura, please help with quick redlines if Procurement asks.

Attachment: SOW_draft_v2.docx (DOCX, 48 KB)

-Karthik
From: Procurement <procure@arcadiaai.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@arcadiaai.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot demo — compact blocks to fit FY planning window

Hi team — procurement here. Quick reality check: the finance blackout for FY lock is 05/25–05/29; committee review for supplemental pilots is this Friday 05/15. If you can get an executable SOW before Friday (even a limited-duration SOW) we have a good shot of issuing a PO by the first week of June. If not, PO will likely move to late June after the FY committee reconvenes.

We prefer a 05/14 brief + 05/15 follow-up cadence (two short sessions) so reviewers see progress across days. Please send an editable SOW and a short one-pager for the committee (1 page).

Thanks,
Procurement Team
Procurement | Arcadia AI

Perfect — thanks for the clarity. We’ll lock to Option A: 05/14 09:30–10:00 PT (intro + data readiness) and 05/15 09:30–10:00 PT (baseline + next steps).

Action items:
- I’ll upload a one-page pilot summary to your Drive and send an editable SOW (SOW_draft_v2) by EOD PT.
- Karthik: 15-min pre-call at 05/13 11:00 PT to confirm test payloads and access (will you join?).
- Laura: please prepare a minimal invoice template and any preferred PO wording we should include.

Elena / Procurement — once we send the SOW, would you prefer DocuSign or a countersigned PDF via email? We’ll accommodate whichever speeds PO issuance.

Thanks — calendar invites to follow.

Best,
